items.description: Law Offices of R. David Williams, P.A. Contents. A complete dossier of the firm's criminal defense practice covering ~175+ clients: felonies (an undercover sex sting involving a minor - Ramirez; domestic violence robbery - Valderrama, involving a 4-year-old child; felony DUI - Segula; fraud - B. Williams), a core caseload of ~10 DUI matters (including an arrest at breath readings of 0.011 and SCRAM alcohol monitoring), violations of probation (VOP), FDLE expungement packets with FD-258 fingerprint cards, a 'red flag' Risk Protection Order (RPO), 2 clients in ICE custody, and a material witness under GPS monitoring for 3+ years. Attorney fees range from $750 to $25,000. The case files include complete police discovery: ~206 GB of bodycam video, 911 recordings, and jail calls, incident reports, photo line-ups, FCIC/NCIC forms, and victim and witness data (Marsy's Law). pulmonaryservicesgrouppr.com zoominfo.com/c/pulmonary-services-group/442368923 Pulmonary Services Group (Medicare-enrolled since 1998, pulmonaryservicesgrouppr.com, Santurce/San Juan + Mayagüez, Puerto Rico) is a three-company group — Respiratory Equipment Leasing and Sales Services Corp., Mayagüez Alquiler y Venta, and Pulmonary Equipment Corp — providing home medical equipment and respiratory therapy services across the island and hospital equipment distribution to Puerto Rico and the Caribbean. Its specialty is home mechanical ventilation for ventilator-dependent patients (neonates to elderly), plus CPAP/BiPAP for sleep apnea, oxygen concentrators, speaking valves, enteral feeding and home-care gear (hospital beds, lifts, mattresses). The company holds JCAHO accreditation since 1998 in respiratory therapy and durable medical equipment, accepts Medicare and most local health plans, and offers 24/7 delivery, installation, training and technical support.

corswarem.eu Corswarem Group (founded 1957, Tongeren, Belgium) is a family-owned manufacturer and installer of aluminium windows, doors, curtain-wall facades, terraces and solar panels, with 65+ years of expertise and 18–20 employees across five legal entities (Ramenconstructie Corswarem NV as the main operating company, plus Alu Design, Window Creations, Solar Solutions and holding Groep ADC BV with €18M in assets). It is a Schüco Premium Partner (30+ years exclusive) and Renson Ambassador, delivering full turnkey projects from design through production to installation — landmark works include BASF Antwerpen, Posthofbrug Berchem (17,000 m² offices), DronePort Brustem, CM Limburg HQ and the first ASE 80 HI DesignLine installation in Belgium. Led by the Corswarem family (Dirk, An, Jolien), the group booked a gross margin of €5.3M at its 2023 peak but saw profit fall 64% in 2025 to €691K amid Belgium's construction slowdown — though equity rose 44% and debt dropped 30%.

With ISO 9001/14001/45001 certifications and 39,000 m² of production facilities in Colón (its own concrete plants, quarries and caisson yards), it self-manufactures critical components — a rare vertical integration in Central America. Its flagship client is the Panama Canal Authority (ACP), for which it has executed compensating-platform repairs, drainage works at the Espíritu Santo and Pirro locks and coastal work for the Third Bridge consortium (~$22–28M). It also builds water-supply systems (Caños de Brea, David pipeline with EMPESA), bridges, dams, breakwaters and drip-irrigation (Netafim) agriculture projects. guybendana.com Guy José Bendaña-Guerrero & Asociados (roots to 1907, Managua, Nicaragua) is the leading intellectual-property boutique in Nicaragua, specializing in trademarks, patents, industrial designs, copyright, plant varieties and anti-counterfeiting, plus corporate law, regulatory (sanitary registrations) and litigation. It traces its lineage over 100 years through three legal dynasties — founders Henry Caldera & Henry Caldera-Pallais (who secured Nicaragua's first Trademark Law in 1907 and co-founded ASIPI in 1964), then the Caldera generation, and since 1985 Dr. Guy José Bendaña-Guerrero (a former judge, law professor, author and ex-president of ANIPI) alongside his wife Blanca Aragón de Bendaña and their son Julián. Recognized as Nicaragua's top IP firm by Chambers and Partners, Legal 500 and World Trademark Review 1000, it serves global pharmaceutical, technology, fashion and consumer-goods clients from its Bolonia district office in Managua. teachenglish.vus.edu.vn zoominfo.com/c/vus---the-english-center/1308758011 VUS (Vietnam USA Society English Centers) (founded 1997, Ho Chi Minh City) is Vietnam's largest English-language school chain — 70+ centers nationwide with 7,000+ staff, 600+ foreign teachers and 250,000+ students a year (3 million cumulative). autohoeller.at zoominfo.com/c/auto-höller/431018598 Auto Höller (family business founded 1968 by Erwin and Monika Höller as a small filling station in Seekirchen) is a multi-brand car dealership and workshop in Eugendorf near Salzburg, Austria, employing 32 staff across two locations. It is an official long-standing dealer for Kia (top-5 Kia partner in Austria), Mazda (one of the largest in western Austria) and Isuzu commercial vehicles, selling new, young ("HÖLLISCH GUT" certified) and used cars plus fleet management, financing and a full-service workshop with body shop and §57a inspection station. Since 2006 it has been led by the founder's son Markus Höller (sole owner across three legal entities: GmbH, GmbH & Co KG and an Immobilien company), with total assets of €5.7M as of end-2024. The dealership is locally famous for its humor-driven marketing ("Höllisch gut" branding, cabaret evenings)

tommygarner.com zoominfo.com/c/tommy-garner-air-conditioning--heating/140230813 Tommy Garner Air Conditioning & Heating (Tommy Garner, Inc., founded 1986 by Tommy and Chrissy Garner in Newport News, Virginia) is a family-owned Class A HVAC contractor serving the Hampton Roads region for 40 years. It provides commercial and residential air conditioning, heating, generators (authorized Honeywell dealer), water heaters, commercial refrigeration and indoor air-quality solutions — with 24-hour emergency service, 30-day service guarantees and 1-year installation warranties. Led today by founder Tommy Garner alongside his son Zach and daughter Lauren Jett, the company employs 35–39 people and was named Virginia Peninsula Chamber Small Business of the Year 2024 and a 2025 Best Places to Work in Virginia (the only HVAC firm on the list). Its reputation is exceptional — an A BBB rating and 5-star reviews from clients including the Virginia Living Museum
